name: Oira wa Bandai 2
source:
Main character regains freedom after sentence for peeping and violating women at bath house. He discovers that his accomplices in crime sold his land. But when he finds former friends, it turns out that they acquired a new bath house with unstained reputation instead. Everything is ready by now, so it's peeping time again.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公因在澡堂偷窥并侵犯女性服刑后重获自由，却发现犯罪同伙已经卖掉了他的土地。但找到昔日伙伴后，他得知众人其实买下了另一家名声清白的新澡堂。一切准备就绪，又到了偷窥的时候。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
